title: Platform maintenance — Sunday 02:00–04:00 IST
body: ferroBid will be unavailable for scheduled maintenance this Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 IST. Live auctions will not be scheduled in this window.

title: Revised EMD policy for lots above ₹20 lakh
body: Effective 15 July 2026, EMD for lots with reserve price above ₹20,00,000 is revised to 5% of the reserve. Existing scheduled auctions are unaffected.

title: New pickup slots at Chennai & Pune yards
body: Evening pickup slots (16:00–18:00) are now available at the Chennai Ambattur and Pune Chakan yards. Choose your preferred slot during logistics scheduling.

title: KYC re-verification drive
body: Buyers registered before Feb 2026 are requested to re-submit KYC documents by 31 July 2026 to continue bidding without interruption.
